directAnswer: To reset a smart display, locate the reset button or use the settings menu, depending on the model. Follow the specific steps for your device to complete the reset process.
summary: Resetting a smart display can resolve issues or prepare it for a new user. The method varies by device brand and model.

sections.heading: Using the Reset Button
sections.body: Most smart displays have a physical reset button. This is typically located on the back or bottom of the device.

sections.heading: Using the Settings Menu
sections.body: If your device does not have a reset button, you can reset it through the settings menu. This option may vary by brand.

steps.title: Locate the Reset Button
steps.detail: Find the reset button on your smart display, usually found on the back or bottom.

steps.title: Press and Hold the Reset Button
steps.detail: Press and hold the reset button for about 10 seconds until the display shows a reset confirmation.

steps.title: Access Settings Menu
steps.detail: If using the settings menu, navigate to 'Settings', then 'Device Options', and select 'Reset'.

steps.title: Confirm the Reset
steps.detail: Follow the on-screen instructions to confirm the reset process.

faqs.question: Will resetting my smart display delete my data?
faqs.answer: Yes, resetting will erase all personal data and settings.

faqs.question: Can I reset my smart display remotely?
faqs.answer: Most devices do not support remote resetting; it typically requires physical access.

faqs.question: What should I do if my smart display doesn't respond?
faqs.answer: Try a hard reset by unplugging the device for 30 seconds, then plug it back in and attempt the reset again.

caveats: Resetting the device will erase all settings and personal data.
Some models may have different reset procedures; refer to the manufacturer's documentation.
